title: Applied Machine Learning using Python
issuer: National Institute of Technology, Kurukshetra, Haryana
description:
Successfully completed a short-term online course on "Applied Machine Learning using Python" organized by the Department of Computer Engineering, National Institute of Technology (NIT) Kurukshetra, held from 3rd to 7th January 2025.

This course focused on practical applications of machine learning using Python, covering key concepts, algorithms, and implementation techniques. Participated as a student of the IIT Madras BS Degree Program.
